summary: Frontend-only validation of the 5 new fullscreen QR / unified card-access / pro social-links features. All 5 features work end-to-end. Verified both PARTICULIER (membre1.demo) and PROFESSIONNEL (pro3.demo) flows, plus the anonymous public card page.

features_result.F1_loyalty_fullscreen_particulier: OK — loyalty-fullscreen-button opens fullscreen-qr overlay with fullscreen-qr-code, title 'Sophie Lenoir [DEMO]' via fullscreen-qr-title, and fullscreen-qr-exit closes it.
features_result.F2_procard_fullscreen_professionnel: OK — pro-card-qr-fullscreen opens fullscreen-qr with title 'Nadia Fournier [DEMO]' and subtitle 'Professionnel'. Exit works.
features_result.F3_unified_particulier: OK — dashboard shortcut-ma-carte and QuickActionsFab quick-action-ma-carte both open card-access-modal with card-access-loyalty and card-access-loyalty-fullscreen. Direct navigation to /loyalty?fullscreen=1 auto-opens fullscreen overlay as expected.
features_result.F4_unified_professionnel: OK — dashboard shortcut-ma-carte and FAB quick-action-ma-carte-pro both open card-access-modal with card-access-pro-fiche and card-access-pro-fullscreen. Direct /profile?tab=pro&fullscreen=procard auto-opens ProCardQr fullscreen. Note: 'quick-action-valider-une-presence' not shown for pro3 because that action is permission-gated (loyalty.stamp) — not a regression, expected behavior.
features_result.F5_pro_socials_and_public_card: OK — pro-social-linkedin/facebook/instagram, pro-website-input and pro-save-button all present. Persistence verified (edited website, saved, reloaded, value persisted, then restored). Public page /carte/{userId} (no auth) shows public-card-website (href=https://example.org/pro3), public-card-socials with public-card-social-linkedin and public-card-social-instagram (facebook absent as pro3 has none set).

critical_code_review_comments: FullscreenQR listens to fullscreenchange and calls onClose when document.fullscreenElement is null. When requestFullscreen is denied by the browser (no user gesture, e.g. via ?fullscreen= auto-open), no fullscreenchange event fires so the overlay stays visible — verified. Still, if a spurious fullscreenchange were emitted at mount time (some browsers/iframes) it could immediately close the overlay. Consider a small guard (ignore first fullscreenchange within first ~200ms after mount) for robustness.
